summary: Complete UI redesign testing of Resume Builder. All 22 features tested successfully. The new 3-panel layout (dark sidebar 200px, form area center, preview panel 420px) works correctly. Entry page shows full-screen hero with two paths. ATS bar auto-collapses after ~6 seconds and can be reopened via score widget. All form fields are large (h-14 = 56px). Quick fix cards display in amber styling with point badges. Navigation via Continue/Back buttons and sidebar sections works. Mobile view correctly hides sidebar and preview panel, showing horizontal tabs instead.
passed_tests: Entry page shows full-screen hero with 'AI-Powered Resume Builder' badge
Two main paths visible: 'Create My Resume' and 'Import Your Resume'
Clicking 'Create My Resume' enters the full-screen editor
Editor has 3-panel layout: dark sidebar (200px), form area (center), preview (420px)
ATS Score bar shows at top with score, 3 category bars (ATS Readiness, Readability, Impact)
ATS bar has 'Fix issues' button and close (X) button
ATS bar auto-closes after ~6 seconds
Score widget in sidebar reopens ATS bar when clicked
Sidebar shows 5 sections (Personal, Experience, Education, Skills, Extras) with icons
Sidebar collapse toggle works (200px -> 56px)
Template picker in sidebar shows 5 templates (Clean, Professional, Minimal, Executive, Modern)
Form fields are large (h-14 = 56px inputs, text-base labels)
Personal tab has Full Name, Email, Phone, Location, LinkedIn, Portfolio, Summary fields
Quick fix cards show in amber styling with +points badges and Fix buttons
Continue button navigates to next section (shows '1/5' counter)
Back button navigates to previous section
Experience tab shows 'Add Experience' button with empty state
Education tab shows 'Add Education' button
Skills tab has skill input and displays skill tags
Extras tab has certification input
Live Preview panel updates as data is entered
Import/Reset buttons work in sidebar
Download PDF and Print buttons visible in preview header
Import Your Resume path shows upload drop zone with .DOCX/.PDF badges
Paste resume text option opens paste mode with textarea
Mobile view shows horizontal tabs and hides sidebar/preview panel
critical_code_review_comments: ResumeBuilder.tsx: Well-structured 3-panel layout with proper responsive breakpoints (lg: for sidebar, xl: for preview)
ATS bar auto-collapse timer (6 seconds) implemented correctly with useEffect cleanup
Score widget provides good UX for reopening collapsed ATS bar
Form fields consistently use h-14 (56px) for large touch targets
Quick fix cards have proper amber styling with emerald point badges
Mobile tabs (data-testid='tab-{section}') provide good navigation on smaller screens
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Resume Builder UI redesign complete. Key data-testids: 'resume-builder-entry' (entry page), 'scratch-option' (Create My Resume), 'upload-drop-zone' (Import), 'paste-option' (paste text), 'resume-builder-editor' (editor), 'editor-sidebar' (left sidebar 200px), 'sidebar-toggle' (collapse to 56px), 'sidebar-step-{section}' (Personal/Experience/Education/Skills/Extras), 'editor-form-area' (center), 'resume-preview-panel' (right 420px), 'ats-score-bar' (top bar, auto-collapses after 6s), 'ats-group-{ats|readability|impact}' (category bars), 'ats-bar-close' (X button), 'score-widget' (reopens ATS bar), 'quick-fix-card' (amber cards), 'quick-fix-btn' (Fix buttons), 'step-continue-btn' / 'step-back-btn' (navigation), 'personal-{field}' (form fields), 'template-{name}' (5 templates), 'tab-{section}' (mobile tabs). Form inputs are h-14 (56px). Preview panel is 420px fixed width.
